verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's docs explicitly tie Session Replay to funnel drop-off analysis ('quickly follow up by exploring why customers drop off') and support saving replay playlists filtered by events or properties, which covers the funnel-to-replay jump for PMs. However, there's no explicit documentation of linking directly from an *error event* to replay sessions, and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming the workflow in practice. Missing for 10: explicit error-event-to-replay linkage, independent user corroboration of the workflow.
